messages:
Mira Chen: Hey folks — Mira here, joined Platform Eng today. Quick access ask: need Redwood Console staging + feature-flag admin on staging for integration work, and prod console readonly. Who should I ping to get this set up?
Samir Patel: Welcome Mira! You can start here. For console roles we use the infra access flow. Can you confirm manager + team?
Mira Chen: Manager: Emma Lopez. Team: Platform SDKs. Staging FF admin only; prod read-only.
Emma Lopez: Confirmed — I approve Mira for staging flag admin and prod readonly. @Samir can you handle the grant?
Samir Patel: Yep. Mira, steps: 1) open https://internal.redwood/accessr 2) request roles `console:staging-admin` and `console:prod-readonly` 3) attach ticket ONB-423 and set Emma as approver. If you hit a 403 paste the exact error here.
Mira Chen: Done the request, ticket ONB-423. It shows "awaiting approval" in the UI.
Samir Patel: I approved the staging admin role — you should get an email. Prod readonly needs security sign-off, looping in @Luca (sec).
Luca (sec): Quick checklist Mira: prod readonly requires SSO + 2FA enrolled. Do you have a 2FA device (Auth app or YubiKey)?
Mira Chen: I set up Google Authenticator on my phone earlier today. No YubiKey.
Luca (sec): That's fine. I verified 2FA and approved the prod readonly. You should be able to view prod flags now, but not publish.
Mira Chen: I can see staging admin and prod readonly. I can create draft flags in staging but publish to prod is blocked — that's perfect for onboarding. Thanks! :tada:
Samir Patel: FYI when testing, toggle flags in the `staging//canary` environment to avoid wide impact. Also ping #eng-sre if you plan a rollout.
devex-bot: New user Mira Chen added to group `console-staging-admin` (uid: u-19384)
Mira Chen: One last q — where's the official runbook for safe flag rollouts?
Samir Patel: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/flag-rollouts — read the section "canary + gradual ramp". It has the checklist you'll want.
Mira Chen: Perfect, got it. Thanks everyone — closing this thread.
